Class MarkdownStyles

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.markdown.MarkdownStyles
public final class MarkdownStyles extends Object
Programmatic style overrides for MarkdownView. Each slot is independently overridable; slots the caller does not touch fall back to the CSS resolver (when one is configured) and finally to a built-in default. The precedence is therefore explicit programmatic value > CSS > default, matching the convention documented in AGENTS.md for CSS-compatible widgets.

Defaults:

  • headings: bold (level 1 also reversed for emphasis)
  • strong: bold
  • emphasis: italic
  • strikethrough: crossed-out
  • inline code: gray foreground, dim
  • code block: gray foreground
  • link: blue, underlined
  • blockquote: dim
  • list marker: cyan
  • html: dim, gray
